verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no built-in, in-product AI assistant that a user can hand tasks to. Kick's in-product AI runs automatic categorization and transfer matching, logged under a Kick agent; that is background automation, not task delegation. The natural-language delegation surfaces ("ask it to look things up, make changes") rely on external assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor connected via MCP/CLI, or on AI inside Google Sheets. Both are adjacent features or host tools, not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
